name: EarningFram
fix_description: Add reentrancy protection to the token transfer function, or follow checks-effects-interactions: burn shares before calling controller.withdraw(). The current code transfers tokens via controller (which triggers a callback), then uses balanceOf(msg.sender) to cap shares — but the transfer already moved tokens away, making balanceOf return 0 and _burn(0) a no-op.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit is a protocol-specific reentrancy/share-accounting attack that requires understanding vault deposit/withdraw logic, convertToAssets behavior, and the controller-triggered callback flow. The PoC is still fairly compact and uses a single flash loan plus one helper contract, so it is more involved than a trivial bug but not a deeply complex multi-protocol attack chain.
